As a follow up note:
If the intended behavior is to be able to use function returns in raw format for print calls the OS.get_unique_id() result would be parsed differently due to a mac IOKit likely returning something like 00000000-0000-1000-8000-010203040506

The clue provided by the OP that the print call worked on MAC yet windows presented with curly brackets (and that seemed out of place) helped me derive the improvement. This will handle pretty much any print call where a function is passed that may need to be redirected to rich_print() instead.

Thank you, works. But if I continue appending strings to the same print() statement after device_unique_id, any additional content is not displayed.
